title: Essential Stationery for IB Students
summary: A practical stationery list for IB students, covering everyday study supplies, subject-specific equipment, organization, and examination rules.
body_markdown:
The essential stationery for IB students is straightforward: reliable blue or black pens, pencils, an eraser, a sharpener, a ruler, highlighters, paper, subject folders, and a planning system. Mathematics and some other subjects also require an approved calculator, while geometry instruments, graph paper, index cards, or specialist art materials depend on the chosen courses.


Students should avoid buying an elaborate collection before classes begin. School policies, subject choices, assessment formats, and teacher preferences determine which additional supplies are genuinely useful. This guide separates everyday study materials from examination equipment and explains how to build an efficient system without unnecessary expense.


### Essential IB stationery checklist


A sensible starter kit should cover writing, calculation, annotation, organization, and deadline management.


Item Suggested quantity Main purpose


Blue or black ballpoint pens 3 to 5 Notes, essays, tests, and examination practice


Pencils 2 to 3 Graphs, diagrams, sketches, and planning


Eraser and sharpener 1 each Correcting pencil work


30 cm ruler 1 Graphs, tables, diagrams, and underlining


Highlighters 2 to 4 colours Identifying arguments, evidence, and definitions


Lined paper or notebooks One system per subject Notes and written practice


Squared or graph paper One pad or notebook Mathematics, sciences, economics, and data work


Folders or binder sections One per subject Worksheets, feedback, and assessed work


Planner or digital calendar 1 Coursework, tests, and revision deadlines


Index cards or flashcards Optional Active recall of formulas, vocabulary, and examples


Choose dependable products rather than premium ones. A pen that writes consistently and a folder that closes securely are more valuable than decorative supplies that make a school bag heavier. The provides a compact preparation checklist.
